newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping sugar.

Vessels: Mannan loading 14,000 tonnes sugar using big bags. Kallang loading 14,000 tonnes using big bags. Waiting to dock, four vessels to load sugar using big bags and two to load bulk. Road: 485 trucks carrying sugar arrived between July 18 and 20. Loading (July 18-20): 7,878 tonnes using big bags, 8,500 tonnes bulk.

Vessels: Tai Pan, Manley Exeter, Jurata and George B. each loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Mattz Spica loading 12,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Mariner II loading 25,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Waiting to dock, two vessels to load bulk sugar and six to load sugar (unspecified). At Cargill private terminal, no vessels docked. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load bulk sugar and two unspecified.
Stocks: 9,337 tonnes bulk in CODESP warehouses, no bagged sugar. Private warehouses already with bagged sugar but stock levels unavailable.
